findings.title: Verifier sandbox exposes undeclared engine-file metadata, breaking replay invariance
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 4 requires missing dependency declarations to fail before entry; Criterion 5 requires a sandbox that cannot read undeclared engine files; Criterion 6 requires undeclared post-D02 byte changes never to alter the same candidate's verdict.
findings.trigger: A D01/D02-valid curriculum declares an empty verifier dependency set, while its frozen invocation names an undeclared engine file and the verifier branches on that file's `stat().st_size`; the file's bytes change after D02 without changing the candidate or frozen contract.
findings.consequence: D08 returns contradictory PASS/FAIL verdicts for the same candidate and contract, so replay is repository-state-dependent and a fresh cascade can admit or reject based on undeclared post-freeze state.
findings.evidence: `runtime/langgraph_factory/transport.py:665` grants global `(allow file-read-metadata)`. The reproduction at `QA/exec/test_rc15_sandbox_probe.py:14-58` first runs real D01 and D02 against `rc15_synthetic_curriculum/synthetic_curriculum.v1.yaml`, whose dependencies are `[]`, then executes the sandboxed verifier twice. Command: `python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider plans/27_langgraph_curriculum_factory_remediation/execution_package_v2/release_candidate/rc15/QA/exec/test_rc15_sandbox_probe.py`. Observed candidate SHA-256 `9ec5fbe0c468001e40d930c24c7ea44f9774d49901bf72416000a9c2cf8935cf` both times; four-byte undeclared input produced `observed-size: 4` and PASS, while changing only that file to five bytes produced `observed-size: 5` and FAIL. Both fixture suites completed, otherwise `verify_domain` would have raised before returning either receipt.

observations: The supplied review-bundle SHA-256 and all claimed graph/spec/schema/contract digests recomputed correctly; graph v8 retained the required hash.
The active Arduino circuit-library drift reproduction now fails closed before verifier execution with `VerifierFault: verifier dependency 3 changed after D02 froze it`.
The real plan validator, ownership verifier, complete-tree scanner, 176 package tests, 797 focused tests, and full runtime suite (`1350 passed, 2 skipped, 419 subtests passed`) succeeded.

Verifier executions reuse sandbox rules that expose model-CLI Keychain/Codex authentication paths. A verifier-specific profile without those rules would be prudent hardening, but this was not promoted to a finding under the stated criteria.
reasoning: Most RC15 claims held under execution, including the intended RC14 circuit-library fix and the full regression denominators. The surviving blocker is narrower: byte reads are scoped, but metadata reads remain globally allowed. A reachable D01→D02 contract demonstrated that this metadata channel changes the exact same candidate's D08 verdict after an undeclared repository-byte change, directly contradicting the absolute replay-invariance requirement.
